title: Step manifest (IPE)
description: Written beside a data-producing step's output (ADR-0102 §1). Ties each output to the run, the commit, the query at that commit and its parameters. Metadata only, never data values. Written and checked by scripts/python/run_evidence.py.

source.description: The source system, as named in systems-of-record.yaml where it is one.

query_path.description: The query or script, as a path in the repository.

query_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the query as committed (git show <commit>:<path>), present exactly when query_path is.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the full file, kept even when the file is not.

columns_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the column names, newline-joined, in order.

copy.description: What the write-once copy holds (ADR-0102 §5): the file (non-personal data), a pseudonymised extract, or nothing but this hash.
